Inspraak op de parkeerverordening binnen: Public participation on the city centre parking by-law
Reageren kan tot 31 oktober 2026, daarna: You can respond until 31 oktober 2026, then the consultation closes by itself
Alleen goedgekeurde reacties tellen mee: Only approved responses count towards the consultation. Each new response first waits for moderation, because this consultation moderates in advance.
Bewoners van de Kerkstraat hebben geen e: Residents of the Kerkstraat have no driveway of their own. One permit per address is too few for families with two cars.
Graag de laadpalen in de Molenstraat lat: Please keep the charging points in the Molenstraat when the blue zone goes.
Waarom moeten bezoekers van de zorgprakt: Why must visitors to the care practice on the Havenkade go to the garage on the edge? That is too far to walk for older people.
